name: PetroCore
description: Belgium's leading supplier of high-performance racing fuels and lubricants.
story: PetroCore has been at the forefront of lubricant technology since 1958, developing fuels and oils that push the boundaries of performance. Motorsport is the ultimate testing ground for our innovations, and we seek partnerships with teams that share our dedication to excellence. We believe a partnership with a successful team will showcase the reliability and performance benefits of PetroCore products on the world stage.
